name: Đến kỳ thanh toán
prompt: Create ONE production-quality Vietnamese transactional email visual, not a website. 1024x1536 portrait; entire email visible, white outer margin, natural centered 600px layout, no browser chrome. AUTHORITATIVE REFERENCE: attached image is the exact user-approved AN KHANG HOME email crop. Preserve its real white logo plaque with navy/green AK + AN KHANG HOME wordmark, emerald illustrated apartment-building banner, large white headline at left, illustration at right, curved pale mint lower edge, left-aligned body, thin fact dividers, signature. Match the reference closely; do not invent a different brand. EXACT TEMPLATE: Đến kỳ thanh toán; audience Khách thuê; banner headline exactly 'ĐẾN KỲ THANH TOÁN'. Semantic palette: blue; original logo colors remain navy/green. Banner illustration: cream apartment building, electric and water meters, a simple round still-photo camera icon (same kind as a mobile phone camera app icon), and calendar. NEVER draw a CCTV or surveillance camera. This is a start-of-month reminder before an invoice exists; avoid invoice sheets, success checkmarks, paid stamps or transaction amounts. Use a refined flat editorial illustration, not 3D. Date anchor 09/10/2026 Vietnam UTC+7; all supplied facts are synthetic and exact. BODY: Xin chào Nguyễn Minh Anh, Đã đến kỳ thanh toán của Phòng 221. Vui lòng vào pay.phongtroankhang.com để bắt đầu.  Facts: Phòng: Phòng 221; Kỳ thanh toán: 10/2026. Add exactly one emerald button 'Bắt đầu thanh toán' and note 'pay.phongtroankhang.com'. Close with 'Trân trọng,' and 'Đội ngũ An Khang Home'. Add tiny footer 'Dữ liệu minh họa · 09/10/2026'.  AVOID: Gmail/browser UI, tabs, device frame, other brands, SPX, QR, passwords, fake phone/contact details, clutter, cards inside cards, multiple CTAs, repeated headings, tiny unreadable text, clipped footer, misspelled Vietnamese, unsupported success stamp, invented amounts, people, photorealistic luxury real estate, code or HTML annotations. TEMPLATE-SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS: This email only invites the tenant to begin the monthly workflow on https://pay.phongtroankhang.com. The invoice DOES NOT EXIST YET. Do not show an invoice table, balance, amount, deadline, QR or a paid status. Exactly two fact rows: room and payment period. Preserve the reference hierarchy; explain camera meter reading before invoice generation before payment using only the supplied concise body. The CTA opens pay.phongtroankhang.com. CRITICAL PALETTE OVERRIDE: preserve the reference layout and illustration style, but RECOLOR THE ENTIRE LARGE BANNER BACKGROUND to blue. The semantic color must dominate the banner, not merely appear in a tiny icon. Only the original AK logo retains navy/green. Do not keep the emerald banner for this template.
